summary: The CohortRotations system facilitates the management and scheduling of cohort rotations within a course's timetable. It supports functionalities like adding, editing, and deleting timetable rotations, copying rotations from another course, and validating rotation dates against course start and end dates.
purpose: The system is designed to manage cohort rotations within academic courses, allowing users to efficiently organize and control the scheduling of classes and rotations.

fields.name: TimetableStartDate
fields.description: The start date of the timetable for a course.

fields.name: TimetableEndDate
fields.description: The end date of the timetable for a course.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The start date for a specific rotation.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The end date for a specific rotation.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Handles rotation management tasks such as adding, editing, and deleting rotations.

workflows.name: Manage Timetable Rotations
steps: The page processes a query string to load the correct timetable if TimetableID is provided.
User can add a new rotation by clicking the 'Add' button, which switches the detail view to Add mode.
Edit an existing rotation by selecting it and choosing to edit, which populates the details view.
Save changes by clicking 'Save', triggering validations and update processes.
Copy rotations from another course using the provided dropdown and button functionality.
Validate start and end dates against the course's timetable dates using custom JavaScript functions.

business_rules: Rotation dates must be within the timetable's start and end dates.
Users must be non-read-only to perform add, edit, or delete operations.
validations: Ensure StartDate is before or on the same day as EndDate.
StartDate and EndDate must be within the TimetableStartDate and TimetableEndDate range.
Custom client-side validation ensures dates are correctly configured according to rules.
conditions: If no timetable entries exist, default StartDate to TimetableStartDate.
system_behavior: Displays messages on form errors or warnings.
Handles AJAX updates and panel visibility changes.
dependencies: Dependency on the HSPnet DataLayer for operations on timetable rotations.
Usage of AJAX Control Toolkit for front-end enhancements.
exceptions: If no data is found for rotations, a message is displayed prompting the user to add new data.
